scope: Dallas County (Dallas, Irving, Garland, Mesquite, Grand Prairie) - food, housing, utilities, cash_assistance, transportation, plus local providers

records.name: North Texas Food Bank - Food Assistance and SNAP Application Help
records.description_en: The food bank supplies food pantries and mobile food pantries across North Texas. Staff can also help you apply for SNAP and other benefits.
records.description_es: El banco de comida surte a despensas de comida y despensas móviles en todo el norte de Texas. El personal también le puede ayudar a pedir SNAP (cupones de comida) y otros beneficios.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people and families in North Texas who do not have enough food. Each partner pantry may have its own rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas y familias del norte de Texas que no tienen suficiente comida. Cada despensa puede tener sus propias reglas.
records.how_to_apply: Use the pantry finder or mobile pantry finder at ntfb.org to find food near you. For SNAP help, call (214) 269-0906 or email snap@ntfb.org.
records.how_to_apply_es: Use el buscador de despensas o de despensas móviles en ntfb.org para encontrar comida cerca de usted. Para ayuda con SNAP, llame al (214) 269-0906 o escriba a snap@ntfb.org.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 8:30 a.m.-4:30 p.m.; Saturday 8:30 a.m.-3:30 p.m.
records.notes: Food is given out through partner pantries and mobile distributions, not at the Plano headquarters. The listed hours are for the headquarters office. SNAP and benefits help: (214) 269-0906, snap@ntfb.org. Serves multiple North Texas counties including Dallas.

records.name: Comprehensive Energy Assistance Program (CEAP)
records.organization: Dallas County Health and Human Services
records.description_en: Helps pay electric and gas bills for low-income households. It can also help repair heating and cooling units during weather emergencies.
records.description_es: Ayuda a pagar las facturas de luz y gas de hogares con bajos ingresos. También puede ayudar a reparar equipos de calefacción y aire acondicionado durante emergencias por el clima.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Dallas County households with income at or below 150% of the federal poverty level. You must be a U.S. citizen, non-citizen national, or legal resident. One application per household per calendar year.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares del condado de Dallas con ingresos iguales o menores al 150% del nivel federal de pobreza. Debe ser ciudadano de EE. UU., nacional no ciudadano o residente legal. Solo se permite una solicitud por hogar cada año.
documents_needed: Proof of citizenship or legal status for all household members (birth certificate, U.S. passport, naturalization or citizenship certificate)
Photo ID or other ID for all household members (driver's license, Social Security card, Medicare card)
Full Social Security numbers for all household members
Proof of gross income for the past 30 days for everyone 18 and older
If reporting no income: a TWC Wage Detail Inquiry with a Workforce Solutions stamp, dated within 30 days
Front and back copies of your electric and gas bills
SNAP letter or housing letter if you have one
records.how_to_apply: Call (214) 819-1848 to schedule an appointment. Appointments are required and there are no walk-ins. Processing takes 4-6 weeks, so keep paying your bill or make a plan with your provider.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (214) 819-1848 para hacer una cita. Se necesita cita y no se atiende sin cita. El trámite tarda de 4 a 6 semanas, así que siga pagando su factura o haga un plan con su compañía.
records.hours: Monday-Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.
records.notes: County page (checked 2026-09-26) says CEAP is open, by appointment only. Document list from the county's CEAP Program Requirements 2026 PDF. Applications are processed in the order received.

records.name: Weatherization Assistance Program (WAP)
records.organization: Dallas County Health and Human Services
records.description_en: Makes homes more energy efficient to lower utility bills. It can also fix health and safety problems and do minor home repairs.
records.description_es: Hace que las casas usen menos energía para bajar las facturas. También puede arreglar problemas de salud y seguridad y hacer reparaciones pequeñas en la casa.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income Dallas County residents. A home can get this help once every 15 years.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del condado de Dallas con bajos ingresos. Una casa puede recibir esta ayuda una vez cada 15 años.
documents_needed: Completed WAP application form
Supporting documents listed on the application
records.how_to_apply: Download the WAP application from the county website, fill it out, and mail it or bring it to the office. Appointments are preferred for in-person visits.
records.how_to_apply_es: Descargue la solicitud de WAP en la página del condado, llénela y envíela por correo o llévela a la oficina. Es mejor hacer cita para ir en persona.
records.hours: Monday-Friday, 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
records.notes: WAP lines: (214) 819-1909 and (214) 819-1976. Main DCHHS line: (214) 819-2000. Mail to: Dallas County Department of HHS, ATTN: WAP, 2377 N. Stemmons Freeway, Suite 336, Dallas, TX 75207-2710.

records.name: Dallas County Housing Choice Voucher Program (Section 8)
records.organization: Dallas County Health and Human Services - Housing Agency
records.description_en: Helps low- to moderate-income residents pay rent for safe housing. It also offers a Family Self-Sufficiency program and a homeownership program for voucher holders.
records.description_es: Ayuda a personas con ingresos bajos o moderados a pagar la renta de una vivienda segura. También ofrece un programa de autosuficiencia familiar y un programa para comprar casa para quienes tienen el vale.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low- to moderate-income households. The waiting list is currently closed.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares con ingresos bajos o moderados. La lista de espera está cerrada en este momento.
records.how_to_apply: The waiting list is closed right now. Call the housing agency to ask when it will open again.
records.how_to_apply_es: La lista de espera está cerrada ahora. Llame a la agencia de vivienda para preguntar cuándo se abrirá otra vez.
records.hours: Monday-Friday, 8 a.m. - 5 p.m.
records.notes: The waiting list was listed as closed when checked 2026-09-26, so people cannot apply right now. For people living in the City of Dallas, the Dallas Housing Authority (DHA) takes preliminary applications year-round.

records.name: Older Adult Services
records.organization: Dallas County Health and Human Services
records.description_en: Offers meals, rides, health checks, fitness, and social activities at senior centers across Dallas County. Staff can also help with benefits counseling.
records.description_es: Ofrece comidas, transporte, chequeos de salud, ejercicio y actividades sociales en centros para personas mayores en todo el condado de Dallas. El personal también puede orientarle sobre beneficios.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Dallas County residents age 60 and older.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del condado de Dallas de 60 años o más.
records.how_to_apply: Call (214) 819-1860 to ask about meals, rides, and the senior center closest to you.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (214) 819-1860 para preguntar sobre comidas, transporte y el centro para personas mayores más cercano a usted.
records.notes: County reports about 800 meals per day and 70,000 trips per year across 18 senior centers. Hours vary by senior center. Main DCHHS line: (214) 819-2000.

records.name: Wrongful Eviction Prevention Program (WEPP)
records.organization: Dallas County Health and Human Services with Dallas Eviction Advocacy Center (DEAC)
records.description_en: Gives free legal advice or a lawyer to tenants facing a wrongful eviction.
records.description_es: Da consejos legales gratis o un abogado a inquilinos que enfrentan un desalojo injusto.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Dallas County residents at or below 200% of the federal poverty level who are facing a wrongful eviction and cannot pay for a lawyer.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del condado de Dallas con ingresos iguales o menores al 200% del nivel federal de pobreza que enfrentan un desalojo injusto y no pueden pagar un abogado.
records.how_to_apply: Contact the Dallas Eviction Advocacy Center by phone at (469) 436-2704, by email at info@dallaseac.org, or with the online contact form. You will sign an agreement with DEAC and fill out an intake sheet.
records.how_to_apply_es: Comuníquese con el Dallas Eviction Advocacy Center al (469) 436-2704, por correo a info@dallaseac.org o con el formulario en línea. Firmará un acuerdo con DEAC y llenará una hoja de admisión.
records.notes: Act fast: eviction cases have short court deadlines. DEAC's own site says it serves all Dallas County tenants regardless of income, race, immigration status, or native language; the county-funded WEPP portion uses the 200% FPL limit (self-certified).

records.name: Housing Choice Voucher Program
records.description_en: Helps pay rent in private housing for low- to moderate-income families, older adults, and people with disabilities.
records.description_es: Ayuda a pagar la renta en viviendas privadas para familias con ingresos bajos o moderados, personas mayores y personas con discapacidades.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low- to moderate-income households. DHA checks full eligibility after you are pulled from the waiting list.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares con ingresos bajos o moderados. DHA revisa si usted califica cuando le toca su turno en la lista de espera.
documents_needed: Active email account
Names and ages of all household members
Annual household income
records.how_to_apply: Create an account on DHA's online RentCafe portal, choose the Housing Choice Voucher waiting list, and submit a preliminary application. DHA accepts pre-applications at any time.
records.how_to_apply_es: Cree una cuenta en el portal RentCafe de DHA, elija la lista de espera del programa de vales (Housing Choice Voucher) y envíe una solicitud preliminar. DHA acepta solicitudes en cualquier momento.
records.hours: Monday-Thursday 8 a.m. - 5:30 p.m.; Friday 8 a.m. - 12 p.m.
records.notes: Pre-applications stay on the waiting list until selected or for up to 18 months. TTY 711.

records.name: Discount GoPass Tap Card (50% off fares for benefit recipients)
records.description_en: Gives 50% off local DART bus and train fares to people who get certain public benefits. The card is free.
records.description_es: Da 50% de descuento en los pasajes locales de autobús y tren de DART a personas que reciben ciertos beneficios públicos. La tarjeta es gratis.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people enrolled in SNAP, Texas Medicaid, Medicare, CHIP, TANF, CEAP, WIC, the Housing Choice Voucher Program, Dallas Housing Authority, or Parkland Financial Assistance.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas inscritas en SNAP, Medicaid de Texas, Medicare, CHIP, TANF, CEAP, WIC, el programa de vales de vivienda, la Autoridad de Vivienda de Dallas (DHA) o la Asistencia Financiera de Parkland.
documents_needed: Current participant card with an expiration date, or an agency letter, showing your name
records.how_to_apply: Register online on the DART website or call (972) 482-4052. You must load at least $6 at the start, and the card arrives by mail within 15 business days.
records.how_to_apply_es: Regístrese en línea en la página de DART o llame al (972) 482-4052. Debe cargar al menos $6 al inicio, y la tarjeta llega por correo en unos 15 días hábiles.
records.notes: Renew at the DARTmart at Akard Station.

records.name: Reduced Fare GoPass Tap Card
records.description_en: Gives 50% off DART bus, rail, and TRE fares for seniors, veterans, people with disabilities, children, and students.
records.description_es: Da 50% de descuento en pasajes de autobús, tren y TRE de DART para personas mayores, veteranos, personas con discapacidades, niños y estudiantes.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For adults 65 and older, veterans, people with disabilities, children 5-14, and high school or full-time college/trade school students with the right ID. Children under 5 ride free with a paying adult.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para adultos de 65 años o más, veteranos, personas con discapacidades, niños de 5 a 14 años y estudiantes de preparatoria o de universidad o escuela técnica de tiempo completo con la identificación correcta. Los niños menores de 5 años viajan gratis con un adulto que paga.
documents_needed: Proof of eligibility for your category (such as proof of age, veteran status, student ID, or a medical certificate or state/federal disability ID)
records.how_to_apply: Apply online at dartaccess.dart.org/reducedfareid/ for your category. DART checks your eligibility and mails a DART photo ID card.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea en dartaccess.dart.org/reducedfareid/ según su categoría. DART revisa si califica y le envía por correo una tarjeta con foto.
records.hours: Customer Service: 5 a.m.-midnight daily; 8 a.m.-5 p.m. holidays (closed Thanksgiving and Christmas)
records.notes: After verification, veteran cards arrive in 7-10 business days and senior cards in 15 business days. Children under 5 ride free with a paying adult (up to 2 children).

records.name: DART Paratransit Service
records.description_en: Curb-to-curb rides for people with disabilities who cannot use regular DART buses or trains. Paratransit ID holders and their registered attendants also ride GoLink free.
records.description_es: Viajes de acera a acera para personas con discapacidades que no pueden usar los autobuses o trenes normales de DART. Quienes tienen tarjeta de paratránsito y sus acompañantes registrados también viajan gratis en GoLink.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people with disabilities who are unable to use DART fixed-route buses or trains.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas con discapacidades que no pueden usar los autobuses o trenes de ruta fija de DART.
records.how_to_apply: Call DART Customer Service at (214) 979-1111 to ask how to apply for paratransit eligibility. For GoLink rides, call (214) 515-7272.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a Servicio al Cliente de DART al (214) 979-1111 para preguntar cómo solicitar el servicio de paratránsito. Para viajes en GoLink, llame al (214) 515-7272.
records.hours: Customer Service: 5 a.m.-midnight daily; 8 a.m.-5 p.m. holidays
records.notes: The official page confirms the service but does not list application steps; ask Customer Service. DART also offers Travel Training for people with disabilities.

records.name: Behavioral Health and Crisis Services
records.description_en: The state-designated local behavioral health authority for Dallas County. It runs a 24/7 crisis line and connects people to mental health and substance use treatment.
records.description_es: Es la autoridad local de salud mental y conductual del condado de Dallas, designada por el estado. Tiene una línea de crisis 24/7 y conecta a las personas con tratamiento para la salud mental y el uso de sustancias.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people of all ages, whatever their ability to pay or housing status. Sliding fee discounts are available.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de todas las edades, sin importar si pueden pagar o si tienen vivienda. Hay descuentos según sus ingresos.
records.how_to_apply: In a crisis, call (866) 260-8000 any time. To get into care in Dallas County, call (800) 241-8716 or email CCReferrals@ntbha.org.
records.how_to_apply_es: Si está en crisis, llame al (866) 260-8000 a cualquier hora. Para recibir atención en el condado de Dallas, llame al (800) 241-8716 o escriba a CCReferrals@ntbha.org.
records.hours: Crisis line 24/7
records.notes: Also serves Ellis, Hunt, Kaufman, Navarro, and Rockwall counties. Other crisis number: (844) 672-5700. Main office: (214) 366-9407 (call or text), toll free (877) 653-6363. Call 911 in a life-threatening emergency.

records.name: Metrocare Mental Health and IDD Services
records.description_en: Provides mental health care for adults and children, services for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities, veteran services, and homeless and housing services at clinics across Dallas County.
records.description_es: Ofrece atención de salud mental para adultos y niños, servicios para personas con discapacidades intelectuales y del desarrollo, servicios para veteranos y ayuda para personas sin hogar en clínicas del condado de Dallas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in Dallas County who need mental health, developmental disability, substance use, or veteran services.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en el condado de Dallas que necesitan servicios de salud mental, discapacidad del desarrollo, uso de sustancias o para veteranos.
records.how_to_apply: Call (214) 743-1200 or fill out the online contact form. Choose the type of service you need and your preferred location.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (214) 743-1200 o llene el formulario de contacto en línea. Escoja el tipo de servicio que necesita y el lugar que prefiere.
records.hours: Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
records.notes: Address is the administrative office; clinic locations are on Metrocare's locations page. Metrocare's contact page lists the NTBHA crisis hotline (866) 260-8000. Toll free: (877) 283-2121.

records.name: Parkland Financial Assistance (PFA)
records.description_en: Lowers the cost of care at Parkland hospitals and clinics, including primary care, specialists, hospital stays, and prescriptions. It is not health insurance.
records.description_es: Baja el costo de la atención en los hospitales y clínicas de Parkland, como atención primaria, especialistas, hospitalizaciones y medicinas. No es un seguro médico.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Dallas County residents with income below 250% of the federal poverty level. You must apply and be approved.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del condado de Dallas con ingresos menores al 250% del nivel federal de pobreza. Tiene que solicitar y ser aprobado.
documents_needed: Valid photo ID
Proof you live in Dallas County
Proof of income
Number of people in your household
Employment verification form
Asset form (if on Medicare)
Verification of support form (if someone else helps you with money or housing)
records.how_to_apply: Apply online, through Parkland MyChart (Menu > Billing > Parkland Financial Assistance), by mail, or in person at the Patient Financial Services office. Call (214) 590-8831 with questions.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea, por Parkland MyChart (Menú > Facturación > Asistencia Financiera de Parkland), por correo o en persona en la oficina de Servicios Financieros para Pacientes. Si tiene preguntas, llame al (214) 590-8831.
records.hours: Phone: Monday-Friday, 8 a.m.-4:30 p.m.; in-person office: Monday-Friday, 8 a.m.-4 p.m.
records.cost: Free to enroll; co-pays at time of service
records.notes: You must renew before it expires; if it has been more than 6 months since it expired, you apply as new. PFA members also qualify for DART's Discount GoPass (50% off fares).

records.name: Workforce Solutions Greater Dallas - Job Seeker Services
records.description_en: Free help finding a job, including career coaching, resume help, job fairs, and training programs, at nine workforce centers in Dallas County.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para encontrar trabajo, como orientación de carrera, ayuda con el currículum, ferias de empleo y programas de capacitación, en nueve centros de empleo del condado de Dallas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Job search help is open to job seekers. Training programs have their own eligibility rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: La ayuda para buscar trabajo está abierta a quienes buscan empleo. Los programas de capacitación tienen sus propias reglas.
records.how_to_apply: Visit any of the nine workforce centers in Dallas County or call the main line.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite cualquiera de los nueve centros de empleo del condado de Dallas o llame a la línea principal.
records.hours: Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m.
records.notes: Dallas centers: Greenville Avenue (6500 Greenville Ave, Suite 250, 75206, (214) 378-2600); International District (5757 Alpha Rd, Suite 800, 75240, (972) 388-5600); Opportunity (1610 S. Malcolm X Blvd, 75226, (469) 802-1800); Pleasant Grove (1125 S. Buckner Blvd, 75217, (469) 687-3400); Redbird (3560 W. Camp Wisdom Rd, Suite 110, 75237, (972) 709-5377). Garland, Grand Prairie, and Irving centers are listed as separate records.

records.name: Garland Workforce Center
records.description_en: A local job center in Garland offering free job search help, career coaching, and training information.
records.description_es: Un centro de empleo local en Garland que ofrece ayuda gratis para buscar trabajo, orientación de carrera e información sobre capacitación.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to job seekers in Dallas County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto a personas que buscan empleo en el condado de Dallas.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the center during business hours or call ahead.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el centro en horario de oficina o llame antes de ir.
records.hours: Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m.
records.notes: A January 2026 county flyer showed the old Garland center (217 N. Tenth St.) as closed; the current Workforce Solutions site lists this Clara Barton Blvd. address.

records.name: Grand Prairie Workforce Center
records.description_en: A local job center in Grand Prairie offering free job search help, career coaching, and training information.
records.description_es: Un centro de empleo local en Grand Prairie que ofrece ayuda gratis para buscar trabajo, orientación de carrera e información sobre capacitación.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to job seekers in Dallas County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto a personas que buscan empleo en el condado de Dallas.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the center during business hours or call ahead.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el centro en horario de oficina o llame antes de ir.
records.hours: Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m.

records.name: Irving and Irving South Workforce Centers
records.description_en: Two job centers in Irving offering free job search help, career coaching, and training information.
records.description_es: Dos centros de empleo en Irving que ofrecen ayuda gratis para buscar trabajo, orientación de carrera e información sobre capacitación.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to job seekers in Dallas County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto a personas que buscan empleo en el condado de Dallas.
records.how_to_apply: Visit either center during business hours or call ahead.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite cualquiera de los dos centros en horario de oficina o llame antes de ir.
records.hours: Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m.
records.notes: Irving South Workforce Center: 1081 W. Shady Grove Rd., Irving, TX 75060, (972) 573-3600. The old Irving center at 2520 W. Irving Blvd. is closed; use the addresses here.

records.name: Child Care Assistance (Dallas County)
records.organization: ChildCareGroup with Workforce Solutions Greater Dallas
records.description_en: Helps eligible families pay for child care so parents can work or go to school or training.
records.description_es: Ayuda a familias que califican a pagar el cuidado de niños para que los padres puedan trabajar, estudiar o capacitarse.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Dallas County families who meet state child care assistance rules. Eligibility is checked when you apply.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias del condado de Dallas que cumplen las reglas del estado para ayuda con el cuidado de niños. Se revisa si califica cuando hace la solicitud.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online through the Texas Child Care Connection (TX3C) at childcare.twc.texas.gov. For help, call ChildCareGroup's Child Care Assistance line at (214) 630-5949.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea por Texas Child Care Connection (TX3C) en childcare.twc.texas.gov. Si necesita ayuda, llame a la línea de Ayuda para Cuidado de Niños de ChildCareGroup al (214) 630-5949.
records.hours: Monday-Friday, 7:30 a.m. - 5:30 p.m.
records.cost: Parent share of cost may apply
records.notes: Since January 13, 2025, new applications go through the statewide Texas Child Care Connection (TX3C) system. ChildCareGroup main office: (214) 630-7911. Relay Texas: 711.

records.name: City of Dallas WIC Program
records.description_en: WIC gives healthy food on an EBT card, nutrition classes, and breastfeeding support to pregnant women, new moms, and young children.
records.description_es: WIC da comida saludable en una tarjeta EBT, clases de nutrición y apoyo para la lactancia a mujeres embarazadas, mamás recientes y niños pequeños.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For pregnant women, new mothers, and young children who live in Dallas County, meet income guidelines, and have a nutritional need. You do not need to be a U.S. citizen.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para mujeres embarazadas, mamás recientes y niños pequeños que viven en el condado de Dallas, cumplen con los límites de ingresos y tienen una necesidad de nutrición. No necesita ser ciudadano de EE. UU.
records.how_to_apply: Call (214) 670-7200 or text 1-855-957-5424 to make an appointment at one of 16 WIC clinics in Dallas County.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (214) 670-7200 o mande un mensaje de texto al 1-855-957-5424 para hacer una cita en una de las 16 clínicas de WIC del condado de Dallas.
records.notes: Many clinics are open six days a week. Email: ASKWIC@dallas.gov.

records.name: LBU Community Clinic (health center and WIC)
records.description_en: A community health center in Dallas that also runs WIC, which gives free healthy food, breastfeeding support, and nutrition classes to moms and young children.
records.description_es: Un centro de salud comunitario en Dallas que también tiene WIC, que da comida saludable gratis, apoyo para la lactancia y clases de nutrición a mamás y niños pequeños.
records.eligibility_summary_en: WIC is for pregnant and breastfeeding women, infants, and children under 5. Clinic care is open to the community.
records.eligibility_summary_es: WIC es para mujeres embarazadas y que dan pecho, bebés y niños menores de 5 años. La clínica atiende a la comunidad.
records.how_to_apply: Call (214) 761-0956 to make a WIC appointment.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (214) 761-0956 para hacer una cita de WIC.
records.notes: WIC locations: 809 Singleton Blvd. (75212), 4732 W Illinois Ave. (75211), and Texas Native Health, 1283 Record Crossing Rd. (75235). Clinic appointments: (214) 540-0300; eligibility/insurance help: (214) 752-8204. Other clinics: 3111 Sylvan Ave. (75212), 5787 S Hampton Rd., Suite 365 (75232), 915 Brookmere Dr. (75216). Receives HHS health center funding. WIC hours are on LBU's locations page.

records.name: Crossroads Community Market
records.description_en: A choice-style food market where families pick fresh food, including produce, protein, grains, and dairy. A family of four can get about 100 pounds of food each month.
records.description_es: Un mercado donde las familias escogen su propia comida fresca, como frutas y verduras, proteína, granos y lácteos. Una familia de cuatro puede recibir unas 100 libras de comida al mes.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For households with income below federal TEFAP guidelines who live in certain southern and western Dallas County zip codes. You do not need to bring proof of income.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares con ingresos menores a los límites federales de TEFAP que viven en ciertos códigos postales del sur y oeste del condado de Dallas. No tiene que llevar prueba de ingresos.
records.how_to_apply: Call (469) 860-6090 to book an appointment.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (469) 860-6090 para hacer una cita.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 8:30 a.m.-1:30 p.m.; 1st Saturday 9 a.m.-1 p.m.; 4th Thursday evening 1:30-5:30 p.m. (all by appointment)
records.notes: Service area includes parts of Dallas, Grand Prairie (75052), Cedar Hill, DeSoto, Duncanville, and Lancaster zip codes. The site has English and Spanish intake pages.

records.name: Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas - Dallas Office
records.description_en: Free civil legal help for low-income people, including evictions and landlord problems, divorce, custody, and family violence.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal civil gratis para personas con bajos ingresos, como desalojos y problemas con el dueño, divorcio, custodia y violencia familiar.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income people who meet Legal Aid's eligibility rules. Check eligibility when you apply.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas con bajos ingresos que cumplen las reglas de Legal Aid. Se revisa si califica cuando solicita.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online, call the Legal Aid Line at 1-888-529-5277, or visit the Dallas office. For landlord-tenant problems call 855-548-8457. Call the Dallas office directly if you have a court deadline or were served with a lawsuit.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea, llame a la Línea de Legal Aid al 1-888-529-5277 o vaya a la oficina de Dallas. Para problemas con el dueño o la renta, llame al 855-548-8457. Si tiene una fecha límite en la corte o le llegó una demanda, llame directo a la oficina de Dallas.
records.hours: Monday-Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.
records.notes: People who do not qualify can use free self-help resources at TexasLawHelp.org.

records.name: Austin Street Center Emergency Shelter
records.description_en: An overnight emergency shelter in Dallas for adults with nowhere to stay.
records.description_es: Un refugio de emergencia para pasar la noche en Dallas, para adultos que no tienen dónde quedarse.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For women 18 and older and men 45 and older who have no place to stay and can care for themselves. Registered sex offenders cannot be served.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para mujeres de 18 años o más y hombres de 45 años o más que no tienen dónde quedarse y pueden cuidarse solos. No se puede atender a personas registradas como agresores sexuales.
documents_needed: Valid state or federal government photo ID
records.how_to_apply: Walk up to the Welcome Center (open from 8 a.m.). Intake is Monday-Friday 11 a.m.-4 p.m. and beds usually fill before noon, so come early.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya al Centro de Bienvenida (abre a las 8 a.m.). La admisión es de lunes a viernes de 11 a.m. a 4 p.m. y las camas casi siempre se llenan antes del mediodía, así que llegue temprano.
records.hours: Intake Monday-Friday 11 a.m.-4 p.m.; Welcome Center opens 8 a.m.
records.notes: Men must be 45+. Limit of two bags, 25 lbs each. Walk-ups may be chosen by lottery when demand is high.

records.name: The Bridge Homeless Recovery Center - Day and Night Shelter
records.description_en: Day and night shelter for adults experiencing homelessness, with meals, showers, laundry, health care, job help, housing help, and a kennel for dogs.
records.description_es: Refugio de día y de noche para adultos sin hogar, con comidas, regaderas, lavandería, atención médica, ayuda para encontrar trabajo y vivienda, y un lugar para perros.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For adults 18 and older who are homeless. No ID, background check, or sobriety check is required.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para adultos de 18 años o más que no tienen hogar. No piden identificación, revisión de antecedentes ni prueba de sobriedad.
records.how_to_apply: Go to The Bridge and complete intake with an Intake Specialist, any day from 6 a.m. to 7 p.m.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya a The Bridge y haga su admisión con un especialista, cualquier día de 6 a.m. a 7 p.m.
records.hours: Intake daily 6 a.m.-7 p.m.; Day shelter 6 a.m.-5 p.m.; Night shelter 5 p.m.-6 a.m.
records.notes: Guest intake line: (214) 670-1507. Meals: breakfast 7:30-8:30 a.m., lunch 12-1 p.m., dinner 6-7 p.m. (night shelter guests). Criminal history does not disqualify.

records.name: Calvert Place Men's Shelter
records.description_en: Emergency shelter for men with meals, showers, medical help, recovery support, counseling, and job readiness training.
records.description_es: Refugio de emergencia para hombres con comidas, regaderas, ayuda médica, apoyo para la recuperación, consejería y capacitación para el trabajo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For men experiencing homelessness. A valid ID is required.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hombres sin hogar. Se necesita una identificación válida.
documents_needed: Valid ID
records.how_to_apply: Walk in for intake any day from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. No appointment is needed.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya en persona para la admisión cualquier día de 8 a.m. a 6 p.m. No necesita cita.
records.hours: Intake Monday-Sunday, 8 a.m.-6 p.m.
records.notes: Faith-based (Christian) program. Open 365 days a year.

records.name: Center of Hope Women and Children's Shelter
records.description_en: Shelter for women and mothers with children, with meals, clothing, counseling, job training, and licensed child care for infants through kindergarten.
records.description_es: Refugio para mujeres y mamás con hijos, con comidas, ropa, consejería, capacitación para el trabajo y guardería con licencia para bebés hasta kínder.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For women and women with children who need shelter. Women need a valid ID and mothers need birth certificates for their children.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para mujeres y mujeres con hijos que necesitan refugio. Las mujeres necesitan una identificación válida y las mamás necesitan las actas de nacimiento de sus hijos.
documents_needed: Valid ID
Birth certificates for all children
records.how_to_apply: Call (214) 638-2988 for an intake appointment. Intake is Monday-Sunday, 8 a.m.-5 p.m., by appointment only.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (214) 638-2988 para hacer una cita de admisión. La admisión es de lunes a domingo, de 8 a.m. a 5 p.m., solo con cita.
records.hours: Intake Monday-Sunday, 8 a.m.-5 p.m. by appointment
records.notes: Faith-based (Christian) program.

records.name: Dallas LIFE Shelter and Recovery Programs
records.description_en: Provides shelter, meals, and clothing, plus recovery, job readiness, counseling, and medical and dental help.
records.description_es: Ofrece refugio, comidas y ropa, además de programas de recuperación, preparación para el trabajo, consejería y ayuda médica y dental.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For men, women, and families with children who are experiencing homelessness.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hombres, mujeres y familias con niños que no tienen hogar.
records.how_to_apply: Call (214) 421-1380 or email info@dallaslife.org to ask about intake.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (214) 421-1380 o escriba a info@dallaslife.org para preguntar sobre la admisión.
records.notes: Faith-based (Christian). Has programs for seniors, veterans, and children. Intake hours were not listed on the website; call first.

records.name: Homeless Crisis Helpline
records.description_en: A helpline that connects people experiencing homelessness in the Dallas area to shelter and housing resources.
records.description_es: Una línea de ayuda que conecta a personas sin hogar en el área de Dallas con refugios y recursos de vivienda.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people who are homeless right now in Dallas County and nearby areas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que no tienen hogar en este momento en el condado de Dallas y áreas cercanas.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Homeless Crisis Helpline at (888) 411-6802. For rent or utility help, call 2-1-1.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la Línea de Ayuda para Crisis de Personas sin Hogar al (888) 411-6802. Para ayuda con la renta o los servicios, llame al 2-1-1.
records.notes: Housing Forward leads the All Neighbors Coalition homeless response system. Office: 3000 Pegasus Park Dr., Suite 1020, Dallas 75247, (972) 638-5600 - not a walk-in service site.

records.name: Irving Cares Food Pantry
records.description_en: Gives groceries to feed each person in the household three meals a day for a week. You can get food up to 12 times a year.
records.description_es: Da comida para que cada persona del hogar tenga tres comidas al día por una semana. Puede recibir comida hasta 12 veces al año.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For individuals and families in need. The website does not list rules, so call to confirm what you need to bring.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas y familias que lo necesitan. La página no dice las reglas, así que llame para saber qué debe llevar.
records.how_to_apply: Visit during pantry hours or call (972) 721-9181.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya durante el horario de la despensa o llame al (972) 721-9181.
records.hours: Monday 9 a.m.-noon; Tuesday and Thursday 9 a.m.-noon and 1-3:30 p.m.
records.notes: Irving Cares also offers prescription help, employment services, and an 'Invest in Yourself' program (child care, education, employment).

records.name: Irving Cares Rent and Utilities Assistance
records.description_en: One-time help paying rent or electric/gas bills for Irving residents who are behind.
records.description_es: Ayuda de una sola vez para pagar la renta o las facturas de luz o gas para residentes de Irving que están atrasados.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people who have lived in Irving at least 6 months and at their current address at least 3 months, and who have earned income. There are limits on how often you can get help.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que han vivido en Irving al menos 6 meses y en su dirección actual al menos 3 meses, y que tienen ingresos de trabajo. Hay límites de cada cuánto puede recibir ayuda.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: City of Irving resident for at least 6 months

documents_needed: Photo ID (applicant 18+)
Current lease listing all household members (no month-to-month leases) for rent help
Notice to vacate or late notice for rent help
records.how_to_apply: Apply by phone only at (972) 721-9181. A case manager will check your application and set up an appointment.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solo se solicita por teléfono al (972) 721-9181. Un encargado de casos revisará su solicitud y le dará una cita.
records.notes: Rent: earned income must cover rent; all prior months' rent must be paid; no rent help in the last 3 years. Utilities: no utility help in the last 13 months; covers Direct Energy, Ambit, Reliant, TXU, and Atmos; Irving Cares pays only part of the bill. Dallas County CEAP is also offered at Irving Cares: (214) 819-1848.

records.name: Good Samaritans of Garland Food Pantry
records.description_en: A food pantry in Garland that also offers help for unhoused people and referrals to other resources.
records.description_es: Una despensa de comida en Garland que también ayuda a personas sin hogar y da referencias a otros recursos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in need of food. Eligibility rules were not listed; contact the pantry.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que necesitan comida. No se publicaron reglas; comuníquese con la despensa.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the pantry during open hours.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya a la despensa durante el horario de atención.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 9 a.m.-1 p.m.; closed Saturday and Sunday
records.notes: Phone number and zip code were not shown on the website; visit during pantry hours.

records.name: Sharing Life Community Outreach
records.description_en: Food pantry plus emergency help with rent, mortgage, and utility bills. Also offers clothing, hygiene items, financial coaching, and hotel stays during extreme cold.
records.description_es: Despensa de comida y ayuda de emergencia con la renta, la hipoteca y las facturas de servicios. También ofrece ropa, artículos de higiene, asesoría financiera y estadías en hotel cuando hace mucho frío.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For individuals and families facing food insecurity or a financial emergency. Contact them for specific rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas y familias que no tienen suficiente comida o que tienen una emergencia de dinero. Comuníquese con ellos para saber las reglas.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the pantry in Mesquite during open hours (walk-ins welcome) or call (972) 285-5819 to ask about rent, utility, or other help.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya a la despensa en Mesquite durante el horario (puede llegar sin cita) o llame al (972) 285-5819 para preguntar por ayuda con la renta, los servicios u otras necesidades.
records.hours: Pantry: Monday-Thursday 9 a.m.-3 p.m. and 5-7 p.m.; Friday 9 a.m.-noon (seniors 60+ only)
records.notes: Pantry serves Mesquite, Garland, Sunnyvale, Rowlett, Rockwall, Forney, and nearby areas. Balch Springs residents are sent to the Opal J. Smith Food Pantry. W.A.R.M. program gives temporary hotel stays during extreme cold.

records.name: Grand Prairie Housing Choice Vouchers and Housing Programs
records.organization: City of Grand Prairie Housing & Neighborhood Services
records.description_en: Section 8 rental vouchers for low-income families, plus emergency home repair, home rehab for seniors and people with disabilities, and down payment help for first-time buyers.
records.description_es: Vales de renta Sección 8 para familias con bajos ingresos, además de reparaciones de emergencia en casa, arreglos de casa para personas mayores y con discapacidades, y ayuda con el enganche para quienes compran casa por primera vez.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low- to moderate-income Grand Prairie residents. Some repair programs are only for people 60 and older or with disabilities.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes de Grand Prairie con ingresos bajos o moderados. Algunos programas de reparación son solo para personas de 60 años o más o con discapacidades.
records.how_to_apply: Call (972) 237-8176 or visit during walk-in times (Tuesdays 8:30 a.m., Thursdays 1:30 p.m.). Ask about the voucher waiting list.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (972) 237-8176 o vaya en el horario sin cita (martes 8:30 a.m., jueves 1:30 p.m.). Pregunte por la lista de espera de vales.
records.hours: Monday-Thursday 7:30 a.m.-6 p.m.; Friday 7:30 a.m.-12 p.m. (building closed); closed weekends
records.notes: Walk-in times listed as Tuesdays 8:30 a.m. and Thursdays 1:30 p.m.; confirm by phone. Voucher waiting list status was not stated. Grand Prairie spans Dallas, Tarrant, and Ellis counties.

records.name: Now-Forward (formerly North Dallas Shared Ministries)
records.description_en: Offers food, clothing, medical, dental, vision, and counseling services, plus rent and utility help, ESL classes, school supplies, and tax preparation.
records.description_es: Ofrece comida, ropa, servicios médicos, dentales, de la vista y consejería, además de ayuda con la renta y los servicios, clases de inglés, útiles escolares y preparación de impuestos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in need in Dallas County. Contact them for specific rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que lo necesitan en el condado de Dallas. Comuníquese con ellos para saber las reglas.
records.how_to_apply: Call (214) 358-8700 or email help@now-forward.org for emergency aid.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (214) 358-8700 o escriba a help@now-forward.org para pedir ayuda de emergencia.
records.notes: Formerly North Dallas Shared Ministries. Emergency aid: help@now-forward.org; medical: medical@now-forward.org; dental: dental@now-forward.org. Clothes closet: Monday-Friday 12:30-3:30 p.m.
